scope: R=2 fixed-sector spherical reference centered at B, physical L_y about O unchanged

checked.direct_projected_momentum: DERIVED; delta_l=plus_or_minus_1, radial derivative independent of energy gap
checked.offcenter_force_projection: DERIVED; plus prefactor 1/(sqrt(2)*Z_C*a), with signed a
checked.force_corner_boundary_term: QV tends to zero even at r=abs(a); Qprime*V integrable
checked.finite_force_multipoles: Qprime polynomial degree at most l+k; no force multipole model truncation within finite angular state
checked.finite_box_torque_surface_sign: plus z_B/(2*Delta) times integral n_x dn(psi_g) dn(psi_b)
checked.momentum_dipole_dirichlet_domain: x psi_b preserves Dirichlet domain; no analogous surface term
checked.local_s_cusp_legendre_tail: DERIVED for one fixed-r sqrt(1+eta) term only; normalized coefficient O(l^(-5/2))
checked.independence_vs_prolate: different coordinates, basis, coupled assembly and eigensolve; accepted as independent representation

risks: B centering leaves A offcenter cusp; no exponential angular convergence or finite-lmax sufficiency claim
B-origin projected direct/force commutator can close algebraically inside finite common angular/radial space without angular completeness
Force moments share potential multipoles with Hamiltonian; separate spatial kernel spot-check is useful for common-error detection

Algebraic residual is not full-space residual
Second-minus-first Ritz roots do not certify a lower bound on exact spectral gap
Energy convergence does not by itself certify derivative or singular force accuracy
Changing numerical center also changes finite trial space and finite box geometry

angular selection and signed alpha/beta coefficients
